Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the family relationships by following the stepfather’s lineage and proposing Ken Howard’s father (Kenneth Joseph Howard Sr.) as the maternal grandfather. Maternal grandfather should refer to the mother’s biological father—Margo Howard’s father—who is Jules (Julius William) Lederer, Ann Landers’s husband.
